subject: math
description: Construct box-and-whisker plots from a five-number summary and interpret center and spread.
learningObjectives: Construct box-and-whisker plots from a five-number summary.
Identify the minimum, Q1, median, Q3, and maximum from ordered data.
Draw the box, median line, and whiskers on a scaled number line.
Interpret center, spread, and skew from a box-and-whisker plot.
Avoid common errors such as using the minimum and maximum as the box edges.
prerequisites: Order numbers from least to greatest
Find the median of odd and even data sets
Find Q1 and Q3 from ordered data
Read and label a number line scale
